\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{fuzz}
\begin{document}
\begin{schema}{Probe}
  count : \nat
\where
  count \leq 2
\end{schema}
\begin{schema}{InitProbe}
  Probe'
\where
  count' = 0
\end{schema}
\begin{schema}{Step}
  \Delta Probe
\where
  count < 2 \\
  count' = count + 1
\end{schema}
\end{document}
